title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with qortex-query
description: Install qortex-query for vanilla JS, Vue, Svelte, or other frameworks.
content: Install qortex-query using your preferred package manager.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: Add the package to your project:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-query

# yarn
yarn add qortex-query

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-query
